title: DRack: A CXL-Disaggregated Rack Architecture to Boost Inter-Rack Communication
problem: Inter-rack communication in data centers faces bandwidth and latency bottlenecks due to traditional hierarchical network architectures. Modern disaggregated computing requires efficient resource sharing across racks, but conventional network stacks add latency overhead.
motivation: Data centers increasingly need faster inter-rack communication to support disaggregated architectures where specialized hardware is shared across multiple racks.
method: DRack uses CXL (Compute Express Link) to create a disaggregated rack architecture that exposes memory and compute resources directly to remote racks. The system redesigns rack topology to enable low-latency CXL-based access to resources without traversing traditional network stacks.
key_novelty: Applying CXL protocol to disaggregate resources at the rack level, eliminating traditional network indirection for inter-rack communication.
contributions: Improved inter-rack communication latency and bandwidth
Direct resource access mechanism across racks via CXL
Performance evaluation for data center workloads
